summary: Ephemeral runners failing image pulls after container-registry robot-token rotation
description:
Issue summary:
Several ephemeral self-hosted CI runners in prod(us-west) failed to pull container images immediately after a routine robot-account token rotation in our internal container registry. The symptom was ImagePullBackOff/Unauthorized on new ephemeral jobs; some jobs succeeded intermittently depending on node scheduling.

Impact:
- ~18% of ephemeral-runner jobs in the us-west pool failed to start over a 45-minute window (2026-02-28 09:12-09:57 UTC).
- Release pipelines that create short-lived runners (canary builds and nightly releases) were blocked or retried multiple times, increasing CI latency and causing customer-facing release delays.

Environment:
- Cluster: gke-release-us-west1 (GKE autopilot; nodepools running ephemeral-runner DaemonSet)
- Registry: internal-registry.redwood-inference.com (robot account token rotated via Vault transit)
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Rotate registry robot account token via vault write auth/registry/rotate
2) Trigger a release pipeline that provisions ephemeral runners (release-canary job)
3) Observe pod events from ephemeral-runner-created pods; many show ImagePullBackOff due to Unauthorized from registry
4) On same cluster, schedule pod to a node that previously had successful pulls and observe success (intermittent behavior seen in production)
logs_snippets: kubectl describe pod release-canary-runner-xyz: Events: Failed to pull image "internal-registry.redwood-inference.com/release/runner:sha123": rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Error response from daemon: unauthorized: authentication required
docker log (node-12): time=2026-02-28T09:22:11Z level=error msg="GET https://internal-registry.redwood-inference.com/v2/ : 401 Unauthorized"
vault audit: 2026-02-28T09:10:03Z user=automation/registry-rotations action=rewrap token_id=robot-reg-14 rotated=true
kubelet (node-7): time=2026-02-28T09:23:02Z msg="credential provider cache miss; using node-level image pull secret version v1"
investigation_notes:
Hypothesis: The registry robot token rotation updated the secret in Vault and the central k8s secret via the rotation job, but nodes (kubelet/docker) continued to use a cached credential or an older k8s secret reference for a short period. We observed that pods scheduled to nodes which had recently performed a successful pull (cached credentials) succeeded, while pods on nodes that had not refreshed credentials failed with 401.

Findings:
- The rotation job updated the k8s secret (registry-robot-token) at 2026-02-28T09:10:15Z.
- Kube-controller reflected the new secret, but kubelet credential handshake with container runtime showed cached old creds for ~10-15 minutes on affected nodes.
- The ephemeral-runner provisioning flow creates ServiceAccount->imagePullSecrets; when a pod schedules to a node with stale cached credentials the pull fails.
- No Vault failures or KMS errors were found; root cause is cred propagation delay + docker/kubelet cache behavior during immediate high volume of ephemeral provisioning.
comments: Aisha Malik (Support) 2026-02-28T09:28: Support reported spike in ImagePullBackOff from release pipelines; preliminary triage points to registry 401s.
Jonah Kim (Infra) 2026-02-28T09:35: Confirmed token rotation ran. Spun up held nodes to repro; observed docker daemon returning 401 on nodes that hadn't pulled in last 30m.

Miguel Santos (Release Eng) 2026-02-28T09:47: The ephemeral runners create imagePullSecrets per-namespace. Suggest forcing a rolling restart of ephemeral-runner DaemonSet to repopulate node caches as quick mitigation.
Jonah Kim (Infra) 2026-02-28T09:55: Applied rolling restart to ephemeral-runner podset and manually refreshed k8s secret on affected nodes. Failures subsided after ~12 minutes.
Priya Desai (Reporter) 2026-03-03T10:10: Verified pipelines resumed; marking resolved pending follow-up automation.
resolution:
Mitigation applied: 1) Recreated/rolled the ephemeral-runner DaemonSet to force pods to re-init and use the updated k8s secret; 2) Manually refreshed the registry-robot-token k8s secret on nodes where the cache appeared stale; 3) Restarted docker on 3 nodes that persisted 401s.

Permanent fix implemented: Created automation pipeline that runs immediately after any registry robot-token rotation: it updates k8s imagePullSecret, triggers a targeted rolling restart of ephemeral-runner DaemonSet, and warms node credential caches by performing a lightweight authenticated pull on each node. Added telemetry to detect >5% ImagePullBackOffs post-rotation and auto-run the remediation.

Runbook and link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Registry+Credential+Rotation+for+Runners

No rollback required. Post-mitigation monitoring for 24h showed normal job start rates and no repeat occurrences.
